Data Scientist.suggestions: Consider learning Pandas for data analysis, scikit-learn for ML, and Matplotlib for data visualization. Projects and Kaggle competitions help build strong portfolios.

Web Developer.suggestions: Enhance your frontend skills with React, and backend with Node.js + Express. Build full-stack projects and deploy them on platforms like Vercel or Render.

Android Developer.suggestions: Learn Android development with Java or Kotlin. Practice building real apps and explore Firebase integration for backend services.

Machine Learning Engineer.suggestions: Improve your deep learning skills with TensorFlow and Keras. Work on neural networks, CNNs, and model tuning with real datasets.

DevOps Engineer.suggestions: Explore containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes. Learn CI/CD using Jenkins and cloud services like AWS.
